column4: Full-body view of the porcelain maid doll from the character sheet, posed by her puppeteers like an exquisite devotional figurine, exactly the pose the congregation wishes to see. She stands on the tips of her toes, one foot slightly behind the other, body in a gentle S-curve. Her arms are lifted gracefully and held open low at her sides with palms turned up and fingers delicately arranged, like a saint on an altar, wrists bent a little as if held by strings. Her head is tilted slightly upward with a serene, empty, porcelain smile, eyes half-lidded. The skirt is spread neatly, every frill in place: perfect, beautiful, and subtly unnatural, a doll arranged rather than a person standing. Three-quarter front view. No strings and no controller are drawn (strings are added later). The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. Keep the face, flower ornament (orange petals, white center), ball joints and wrist rings consistent with the sheet; she has exactly two arms and two legs.
